subject: Mediation analysis with all binary variables

messages.author: 6b321291d75949a2
messages.subject: Mediation analysis with all binary variables
parts:
Hi there,

I am trying to carry out a mediation analysis where the outcome variable, mediation and main input variable are all binary. 

Is it possible to use the Lavaan programme where all variables in the mediation analysis are binary?

Thank you very much for any advice/thoughts.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Mediation analysis with all binary variables
parts: Is it possible to use the Lavaan programme where all variables in the mediation analysis are binary?

Yes, just declare the endogenous binary variables (i.e., only the mediator and outcome) as ordered=.  The exogenous predictor should be a dummy code (or whatever code you prefer).

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cat.html
